unit_label: Section 7: Beliebiges System, lineare Schar und Integritätsbereich rationaler Funktionen; Existenz der Rationalbasis
title_de: Beliebiges System \Ssys_{n\rho}, lineare Schar \Lsys_{n\rho} und Integritätsbereich \Jdom_{n\rho} rationaler Funktionen. Existenz der Rationalbasis.
translation_source_policy: Translated directly from the audited German source slice. English control, where present in the source pack, is only a sanity witness for older algebraic vocabulary; this unit was not edited from an English or Dutch draft.

Duplicate technical macro block before Section 8; handled as TeX scaffolding, not prose translation.

segment_summaries.content: Section heading: arbitrary systems, linear families, integral domains of rational functions, and existence of rational bases.
segment_summaries.choices: lineare Schar is rendered as linear family rather than pencil because Section 7 defines closure under scalar multiplication and addition.

segment_summaries.content: The rational basis for fields will now yield rational bases for arbitrary systems of rational and whole rational functions.
segment_summaries.choices: ganze rationale Funktionen remains whole rational functions / polynomials vocabulary without adding a parenthetical here.

segment_summaries.content: Defines arbitrary system S_{n rho} of algebraic rank rho, including constants/elements of Omega.
segment_summaries.choices: Größen aus Ω is modernized as elements from Ω in all three target lanes.

segment_summaries.content: Defines a linear family by closure under scalar multiplication and addition.
segment_summaries.choices: Ukrainian лінійна сім'я, Russian линейное семейство, Interslavic linearna familija; all flagged for final review against possible linear-system terminology.

segment_summaries.content: Defines integral domain and field by adding multiplication and quotient closure, with footnote on degree-zero functions.
segment_summaries.choices: Integritätsbereich continues the established lane: інтегральна область / область целостности / integralna oblast.

segment_summaries.content: Builds the smallest linear family containing an arbitrary system by finite linear combinations over Ω.
segment_summaries.choices: rationale Verbindungen/linear presentation are rendered as rational/linear combinations; algebraic rank is explicitly preserved.

segment_summaries.content: Builds the smallest containing integral domain and field by whole rational combinations and quotients.
segment_summaries.choices: ganze rationale Verbindung is цялу/целую/cělu rational combination, matching the introduction lane for polynomial-style combinations.

segment_summaries.content: Combines the three expansions into the construction of the smallest containing field by rational combinations from the original system.
segment_summaries.choices: Italic summary remains italic; Interslavic uses itshape so the Cyrillic reader actually transliterates the statement.

segment_summaries.content: Derives Theorem IV: an arbitrary system has a finite rational basis of algebraic rank rho consisting of functions of the system.
segment_summaries.choices: Theorem number IV remains Roman in all script lanes.

segment_summaries.content: For a linear family, a rational basis can be chosen with at most rho+1 functions and at least rho; applies to integral domains and fields.
segment_summaries.choices: Theorem number V is manually restored in the Cyrillic reader because the deterministic transliterator maps single V to Cyrillic В.

segment_summaries.content: Explains the difference between the rho+1 bound from linear-family structure and the rho bound from minimal-basis existence.
segment_summaries.choices: Anzahlbeschränkung is rendered as bound/limitation on the number of basis functions.

segment_summaries.content: Notes that characteristic properties of systems and smallest containing systems are preserved under the mapping from Section 3.
segment_summaries.choices: Abbildung continues the mapping lane, not a geometric image-only reading.

segment_summaries.content: Technical clearpage and macro definitions before Section 8.
segment_summaries.choices: Handled as technical TeX scaffolding, following the Section 3 macro-segment convention; no prose translation.

Deterministic c->ц is undesirable for alphabetic subcase labels in the Cyrillic reader; a), b), c) are normalized as а), б), в).

Interslavic linearna familija is intentionally transparent and international but needs authority review against linearny sistem/družina alternatives.
ganze rationale Verbindung continues the whole-rational/polynomial combination lane and should be checked again in Section 8 where polynomial integral domains become central.
